supersedes.reason: v2 correctly rejected sequence 1 / attempt 1 creation of all 28 targets but intentionally left exact allocations unresolved. v3 records the independently audited allocation only as a proposed, separately approvable mapping.

auditBasis.finding: The frozen 28 Decision J targets can be partitioned across six sequences without expanding any sequence scope or pre-creating later component assets.

constraints: Each proposedCreateTargets list is an ordered subset of that sequence's proposedAllowedChangeTargets.
The union of all proposedCreateTargets lists must exactly equal Decision J scope.changeTargets.
No target may occur in more than one proposedCreateTargets list.
A later sequence may modify an already-created target only when that target is in its proposedAllowedChangeTargets; it must not create it again.
The mapping is a proposal, not a final authority. It cannot become a runtime return-plan input until independent review passes and the owner separately approves the exact final record bytes.
No firstComponentFullCreate field is permitted in v3.
Derive directories from the ordered proposedCreateTargets list for the return; do not accept an independently entered bootstrap directory list.
Every derived directory must be relative and either equal site or be under site/.
MyBrain/, .git, .figma-gate, p3-drafts, absolute paths, and parent traversals are forbidden.
The final return plan and handoff protocol must bind the same derived directory policy.
Write the intended per-directory journal entry before mkdir; never create a directory before its rollback intent is journaled.
Record createdByThisTransaction for every directory actually created by the transaction.
Rollback processes journaled directories in reverse order.
Rollback may remove a directory only when createdByThisTransaction is true and the directory is empty at rollback time.
If a rollback candidate directory is non-empty, leave it in place, report it, and fail closed; do not force-delete it.
A directory not recorded in the journal is unknown and must never be deleted by recovery, including after a mkdir-before-journal crash.

negativeTestRequirements: N-1: The retained v4 fixture with firstComponentFullCreate.paths outside that sequence's allowedChangeTargets fails; v3 also fails if a legacy firstComponentFullCreate field is supplied.
N-2: The retained v4 fixture where sequence >= 2 creates a file fails; under v3, a sequence >= 2 may create only a target in its approved createTargets allocation, and every other creation fails.
N-3: The retained v4 fixture that enables firstComponentFullCreate at sequence 1 / attempt >= 2 fails; under v3, any bootstrap creation at attempt >= 2 fails.
N-4: proposedCreateTargets do not partition all 28 frozen changeTargets exactly once fails.
N-5: A derived bootstrap directory outside site/ or containing traversal/forbidden roots fails.
N-6: Protocol and return-plan createTargets/derived-directory policies differ fails.
N-7: Rollback finds a non-empty transaction-created directory, preserves it, reports it, and fails.
N-8: Recovery never deletes a directory absent from the journal.
N-9: A crash after mkdir but before the journal state is complete leaves unknown directories untouched and fails closed.
N-10: v1 journal recovery through v2 code passes.
N-11: A v2 journal missing required fields fails.
N-12: Condition-local return authority packet manifest, attachment hash, or identityLeakScan mismatch fails.
N-13: Baseline and current finalized handoff protocols that are not byte-identical fail.
finalizationRequirements: Obtain a new independent design review of this v3 candidate before helper or protocol implementation.
Obtain a separate owner approval for the exact proposed per-sequence mapping and actual final record bytes before setting ownerApproved:true.
Add and pass the listed pure-validation/fixture negative tests without lifecycle, role launch, browser, Figma, or P-11 execution.
Keep baseline and current finalized protocol bytes identical and preserve attachment-only boundaries.
